title: Import Settings: Android system notification to allow file access not visible when requested on import, need to hit back to see it on previous screen
symptom: Upon a new installation of AndroidAPS, when importing backed up settings the first time, an Android system notification is needed to allow access to the file system. However, upon clicking 'Import settings' under the maintenance tab, the user is taken to a new screen titled 'Select file to import' with no buttons or items to execute. Only upon using the system back button does AndroidAPS take the user to the previous screen where the Android system notification for file access finally appears.
cause: The issue was a UX problem where the Android system notification for file access was not visible when requested on import; it only appeared after hitting back. The fix was implemented in a commit.
fix: The problem was fixed by commit d1009e53218e90aac17639ff876b13467057ef4a. The user confirmed that with the latest commit the problem has been resolved.
